displayAddress: Phoebe Road, Copper Quarter, Pentrechwyth, Swansea, West Glamorgan SA1
description:
Discover this beautifully presented two-bedroom coach house style apartment, perfectly situated in Phoebe Road, Copper Quarter. This modern residence offers contemporary living spaces, ideal for those seeking a stylish and convenient home close to Swansea City Centre.

The heart of this apartment is the modern open-plan kitchen, diner, and living area. Thoughtfully designed, the kitchen boasts integrated appliances, creating a seamless and functional space for everyday life and entertaining. The bright and airy living area provides a comfortable retreat.

The master bedroom benefits from a newly fitted en-suite, offering a private and luxurious space. Built-in 'Sharps' wardrobes provide excellent storage solutions, maintaining a clutter-free environment. A further well-proportioned bedroom and a newly updated bathroom complete the accommodation, finished to a high standard. This property also benefits from a boarded attic, offering additional storage space.

Externally, the property includes an allocated parking space for convenience, with additional visitor spaces available. Its prime location in Copper Quarter provides easy access to Swansea City Centre and the train station, making it an excellent choice for commuters or those who enjoy city amenities.

This apartment is an ideal opportunity for first-time buyers or investors looking for a well-maintained property in a desirable location.

Accommodation 

First Floor

Accessed via communal entrance door with steps to the first floor and access into No. 10. 

Hallway

Recently redecorated, with a door providing access to the communal hallway, UPVC double-glazed window to the rear, radiator, useful built-in storage cupboard and airing cupboard housing the gas combi central heating boiler, loft access.

Lounge (4.11m x 3.29m (13’ 6” x 10’ 10”))

A well-proportioned and inviting lounge, recently decorated and benefiting from a UPVC double-glazed window overlooking the front aspect, radiator and access through to the kitchen.

Kitchen (1.99m x 2.58m (6’ 6” x 8’ 6”))

A stylish, recently installed kitchen fitted with a range of matching wall and base units, work surfaces, integrated four-ring induction hob and electric oven with extractor hood above. Further features include a separate fridge and freezer, stainless steel sink unit, plumbing for a washing machine and attractive wood-effect flooring.

Bathroom

Contemporary bathroom comprising a panelled bath with rainforest-style shower attachment over, vanity-style wash hand basin and low-level WC. The room is finished with porcelain tiled splashbacks, heated towel rail and wood-effect flooring, with a UPVC frosted double-glazed window providing natural light.

Bedroom One (3.68m x 2.74m (12’ 1” x 9’ 0”))

A comfortable double bedroom, freshly decorated and featuring a UPVC double-glazed window to the front and radiator.

En-Suite Shower Room

Modern en-suite shower room featuring a walk-in double shower with overhead rainforest-style shower, pedestal wash hand basin and low-level WC. Further benefits include a chrome heated towel rail, porcelain tiled splashbacks and wood-effect vinyl flooring.

Bedroom Two (3.16m x 1.91m (10’ 4” x 6’ 3”))

A second bedroom which has been recently redecorated and benefits from a UPVC double-glazed window to the rear and radiator.

External

To the rear of the property is a communal parking area with the benefit of an allocated parking space.
